page: Microsoft Azure M32pds_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64). Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs.

For local I/O requirements, the instance integrates 1890 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage configurations. Because the architecture relies on ARM processors, x86-specific instruction sets like AVX, AVX-512, and AMX are not supported, requiring software stacks to be compiled or natively supported for arm64 targets. Additionally, standard public IPv4 networking requires separate configuration, as zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default.

With an extensive 512 GB memory pool and substantial direct-attached NVMe storage, the M32pds_v4 offers strong resource density for memory-bound workloads without incurring the overhead of unneeded graphical processing units. This profile suits large-scale in-memory databases, memory-intensive data analytics, distributed caching tiers, and enterprise database systems requiring low-latency scratch space.
